question: The super highway connecting Delhi-Kolkata-Chennai-Mumbai and Delhi is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Golden Quadrilateral.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Golden Quadrilateral **is a public interstate organization interfacing the greater part of the major modern, horticultural and social focuses of India.
 
• It forms a quadrilateral connecting the four major metro cities of India, viz., Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Chennai.
 
• The Golden Quadrilateral (GQ) is the largest express highway project in India.
 
• The 'Golden Quadrilateral Expressway Undertaking' was sent off in the year** 2000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Public Interstate 4 is additionally called the S**her Shah Suri Marg.**
 
• The Diamond Quadrilateral will associate the four super urban communities of India, viz. Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai, like the Brilliant Quadrilateral interstate framework.
 
• A quadrilateral is a plane figure that has four sides or edges, and also has four corners or vertices.
 
• **The Diamond Quadrilateral** is an undertaking of the Indian rail routes to lay out a high velocity rail network in India.
